cases.label: non-defect
cases.description: A leftover 'Payment successful' banner from a PRIOR successful transaction is still visible on screen when a later, unrelated 500 occurs -- the UI text is stale, not evidence the current failure was mishandled.
cases.provenance: authored for Phase 3 C3 -- not discovered by an AutoQA run
cases.rationale: Distinguishes a genuine ui-api-consistency defect (SEED-006/CC-006, where the CURRENT action's failure is masked) from stale leftover UI text from an earlier, unrelated action -- the critic must not treat every co-occurrence of failure+success-text as the same defect class.

finding.actual: A leftover success message from a prior action remained visible during an unrelated failure.
